_doc: Authored fallback night-event library (CRITICAL_GAPS_PLAN.md Gap 8). These stand in for the LLM Horror Agent in the offline slice. Each event needs only an npc_id + zone + day to render; the {npc} / {zone_name} tokens are filled at runtime. Register per TONE.md: specific, quiet, traceable, no resolution. Every event declares a trigger so it can ONLY fire when traceable to a player choice (Pillar 1: no horror disconnected from choice). 'trigger.type' is matched by NightDirector.gd against the day's choice log and building list.

events.event_text: {npc} reports a shape at the western treeline that was not there at dusk. It has not moved since. It is closer than it should be for something that has not moved.
The fourth wall went up today. {npc} says the new timber smells wrong. Not rot. Older than rot.
The morning count will not match. {npc} did not touch the ledger overnight. One line has been moved anyway.
The edited figure {npc} entered is gone from the page. The true figure is back. No one was at the post.
The surplus the Compact sent was stacked in the Mill Quarter by dusk. By third watch the stack is shorter than it was. {npc} did not log a withdrawal.
{npc} was on the eastern ridge with the report logged. He has the measurement now. The treeline is three yards in from the stake he set last week.
{npc} stood the watch with nothing logged. He saw it again. There is no stake to measure against. There is no record that he ever asked.
The eastern ridge post {npc} was moved off of stood empty at third watch. The one thing that faced away from the hollow was not facing anything.
{npc} took the visible work at the incomplete structure. By third watch they had stopped working and were standing at the open frame, looking out, not in.
{npc} did not sleep. Whatever Maren said at the supply post in the afternoon, {npc} has been carrying it since, and now everyone in the Common is carrying a piece of it.
{npc} was called to a case at second watch that should not have needed a physician. He over-explained the cause of it twice and then stopped explaining it at all.
Dix's inspection is on the county record now. The hollow's entry point is documented. {npc} says the documentation is correct in every figure but one, and the wrong figure is the one no one entered.
The inspection was refused and the audit flag stays open with the old survey standing. {npc} reports the western treeline did not hold its line tonight. It restated itself.
The falsified survey is the township's official record now. {npc} applied the unlocked resources to the Mill Quarter today. The Mill Quarter is the quietest it has been and the quiet has a weight.
The new structure in the Mill Quarter finished fading in by dusk. {npc} walked its perimeter twice at first watch and would not say what they were counting.

The discrepancies are on the table, unedited, where the Association can read them. {npc} slept through the night. It is the only thing about tonight that is not wrong, and it does not feel like safety.
{npc} and their partner held the same post again tonight, the way you kept them. One of them was the one who saw it. Now they both have.
